thread:
elena-sales: heads-up — HighFive ISP (EU telecom) asked about a private deployment. They want a hybrid setup (customer on-prem inference + VPC control plane), customer-managed HSM (FIPS), an air-gapped pre-prod option, and a canary rollout. Target: ~16 weeks from contract, but procurement might add time. Can we triage feasibility + deps?

maya-pm: thanks. can you paste the top constraints and any security demands they already shared? also are there any hard dates?

elena-sales: constraints from the sales packet:
- EU-only data path / no cross-border storage
- Customer-managed HSM (they will hold keys)
- Air-gap option for pre-prod and DR testing
- Canary first, then bulk migration
Timeline is 16 weeks target; they asked if we can do an initial canary in 8–10 weeks but said procurement could add 2–6 weeks.

ryan-infra: high-level infra questions:
- Do they expect us to run inference on their on-prem GPUs or run in our Dedicated region with VPC peering? (they mentioned both)
- For control plane reachability: are outbound-only connections allowed from their network, or do they require inbound?
- HSM integration: we need details on customer HSM vendor (Thales/HashiCorp/HSM-as-a-service) and support for PKCS#11 or equivalent.
Also: cert rotation, NTP, and firewall rules will be required — we should draft a minimal network spec.

sara-ml: model questions:
- Which models/weights do they expect to serve? LLM family + size impacts GPU footprint massively. e.g., Llama2-13B quantized vs 70B fp16 changes node counts.
- If they insist on on-prem GPU hosting, ask about target QPS and p99 latency SLOs so we can propose batching/quantization.
Quantization + caching can cut infra by ~3-4x in many cases.

sam-devex: operational items:
- we need to prepare an air-gapped install bundle (images + manifests + checksums) and an offline installer doc.
- provide firewall/IP list + cert thumbprints.
- how will license entitlements be handled for on-prem GPUs? offline license server?
I'll draft a checklist template.

toni-cs: i'll own the intake form and security questionnaire. recommend a 30min technical scoping call with their infra/security leads to capture answers live. @elena-sales can you set up?

elena-sales: booked: Tue 10:00 CET with their infra/security lead. i'll attach the sales packet and procurement contacts.

maya-pm: agreed next steps (short):
1) get model list + expected QPS / latency SLOs from the customer
2) completed security questionnaire (toni to send)
3) hardware hosting preference confirmed (on-prem vs our dedicated)
4) HSM vendor & integration details
After that, product will produce an initial SOW and rollout plan with cost delta for dedicated vs quantized options.

ryan-infra: preliminary dependency checklist to add to intake ticket:
- HSM vendor & procurement lead times (customer responsibility)
- Network: VPN/peering details, IP allowlist, port matrix, cert chain
- Offline install method and accepted checksum verification
- Hardware spec if running on-prem (GPU model, RAM, NVMe for cache)
- Backup/restore and snapshot retention policy for customer-owned data
- Monitoring/tracing egress endpoints and access for our SREs (read-only)
- Redistribution/third-party licensing constraints for model weights

deploy-bot: created checklist IR-5012 and attached draft intake template: https://internal/redwood/tickets/IR-5012

maya-pm: i'll open the intake ticket in our product backlog, tag eng-runtime, infra, devex, and cs. assigning tentative owner @ryan-infra. will attach the checklist and calendar notes.

elena-sales: perfect. please include a rough cost delta in the SOW for (A) dedicated hosted in-region, (B) on-prem quantized setup, (C) full on-prem fp16. they want a ballpark by EOW if possible.

maya-pm: will aim for a ballpark by Fri, contingent on model list + QPS. thanks all.
